t: 德国大部分地区组成了佐尔韦林关税同盟,这是主权国家之间的第一个这样的同盟.
te: Most of Germany forms the Zollverein customs union, the first such union between sovereign states.
dz: 德国大部分地区组成了佐尔韦林关税同盟,这是主权国家之间的第一个这样的同盟.
de: Most of Germany forms the Zollverein customs union, the first such union between sovereign states.

t: 来自英格兰多尔塞特州托尔普多德的6名农场工人因组建工会而被判被送往澳大利亚.
te: Six farm labourers from Tolpuddle, Dorset, England are sentenced to be transported to Australia for forming a trade uni…
dz: 来自英格兰多尔塞特州托尔普多德的6名农场工人因组建工会而被判被送往澳大利亚.
de: Six farm labourers from Tolpuddle, Dorset, England are sentenced to be transported to Australia for forming a trade union.

t: 阿塞塞拉战役被打;这是自由战争在葡萄牙的最后和决定性的接战.
te: The Battle of Asseiceira is fought; it was the final and decisive engagement of the Liberal Wars in Portugal.
dz: 阿塞塞拉战役被打;这是自由战争在葡萄牙的最后和决定性的接战.
de: The Battle of Asseiceira is fought; it was the final and decisive engagement of the Liberal Wars in Portugal.

t: 司法部长若阿金·安东尼奥·德·阿吉亚尔(Joaquim António de Aguiar)颁…
te: Minister of Justice Joaquim António de Aguiar issues a law seizing "all convents, monasteries, colleges, hospices and a…
dz: 司法部长若阿金·安东尼奥·德·阿吉亚尔(Joaquim António de Aguiar)颁布一项法律,从葡萄牙的天主教宗教命令中夺取"所有修道院,修道院,学院,修道院和任何其他房屋",为他赢得了"修道院-基勒"的外号.
de: Minister of Justice Joaquim António de Aguiar issues a law seizing "all convents, monasteries, colleges, hospices and any other houses" from the Catholic religious orders in Portugal, earning him the nickname of "The Friar-Killer".

t: 在纽约市,开始有四起针对废奴主义者的暴动.
te: In New York City, four nights of rioting against abolitionists began.
dz: 在纽约市,开始有四起针对废奴主义者的暴动.
de: In New York City, four nights of rioting against abolitionists began.

t: 近356年后西班牙裁判所正式解散.
te: The Spanish Inquisition is officially disbanded after nearly 356 years.
dz: 近356年后西班牙裁判所正式解散.
de: The Spanish Inquisition is officially disbanded after nearly 356 years.

t: 位于金斯顿乌邦赫尔的威尔伯福斯纪念碑开始建造.
te: Construction begins on the Wilberforce Monument in Kingston Upon Hull.
dz: 位于金斯顿乌邦赫尔的威尔伯福斯纪念碑开始建造.
de: Construction begins on the Wilberforce Monument in Kingston Upon Hull.

t: 奴隶制在大英帝国被废除,因为"1833年废除奴隶制法案"已经生效,尽管在"1843年印度奴隶制…
te: Slavery is abolished in the British Empire as the Slavery Abolition Act 1833 comes into force, although it remains lega…
dz: 奴隶制在大英帝国被废除,因为"1833年废除奴隶制法案"已经生效,尽管在"1843年印度奴隶制法案"通过之前,它仍然是由东印度公司拥有的合法.
de: Slavery is abolished in the British Empire as the Slavery Abolition Act 1833 comes into force, although it remains legal in the possessions of the East India Company until the passage of the Indian Slavery Act, 1843.

t: 都柏林和金斯敦铁路开通,是爱尔兰岛上第一条公共铁路.
te: Opening of the Dublin and Kingstown Railway, the first public railway on the island of Ireland.
dz: 都柏林和金斯敦铁路开通,是爱尔兰岛上第一条公共铁路.
de: Opening of the Dublin and Kingstown Railway, the first public railway on the island of Ireland.

t: 伦敦威斯敏斯特宫的古老建筑大多被烧成平地.
te: Much of the ancient structure of the Palace of Westminster in London burns to the ground.
dz: 伦敦威斯敏斯特宫的古老建筑大多被烧成平地.
de: Much of the ancient structure of the Palace of Westminster in London burns to the ground.

t: 平扎拉大屠杀发生在斯旺河殖民地. 估计有30名诺恩加尔人被英国殖民者所杀.
te: The Pinjarra massacre occurs in the Swan River Colony. An estimated 30 Noongar people are killed by British colonists.
dz: 平扎拉大屠杀发生在斯旺河殖民地. 估计有30名诺恩加尔人被英国殖民者所杀.
de: The Pinjarra massacre occurs in the Swan River Colony. An estimated 30 Noongar people are killed by British colonists.

t: 由皮埃尔-泰奥多尔·韦尔海根创立布鲁塞尔自由大学.
te: Founding of the Free University of Brussels by Pierre-Théodore Verhaegen.
dz: 由皮埃尔-泰奥多尔·韦尔海根创立布鲁塞尔自由大学.
de: Founding of the Free University of Brussels by Pierre-Théodore Verhaegen.

t: 根据1833年废除奴隶制法,在开普殖民地废除了奴隶制.
te: Slavery is abolished in the Cape Colony in accordance with the Slavery Abolition Act 1833.
dz: 根据1833年废除奴隶制法,在开普殖民地废除了奴隶制.
de: Slavery is abolished in the Cape Colony in accordance with the Slavery Abolition Act 1833.

t: 佐尔韦林 (德国关税同盟)开始德国第一次定期人口普查.
te: The Zollverein (German Customs Union) begins the first regular census in Germany.
dz: 佐尔韦林 (德国关税同盟)开始德国第一次定期人口普查.
de: The Zollverein (German Customs Union) begins the first regular census in Germany.
